name: xTool F1 Lite
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension GS005 (exts/GS005), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 115 x 115); module from defaultPower [10] (laserPower). That it is a blue diode is not stated in the extension. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
